entities.summary: The Most Rev. Patrick Coveney, Titular Archbishop of Satrianum, was a senior-ranking Irish prelate of the Catholic Church who worked in the diplomatic service of the Holy See from 1966 to 2009. He became an archbishop in 1985 and fulfilled several assignments as Apostolic Nuncio, including stints in Zimbabwe, Ethiopia, New Zealand, and Greece.
